'''Veneb Drassk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who used the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gwarror]] to eliminate his rivals and ascend to a position of power and acquire a [[Veneb Drassk's clan|clan]]. He nearly became the [[Clan Speaker]] for all Trandoshan clans, but was killed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] around [[3641 BBY]] by [[Qyzen Fess]] and the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
